_about: Published restaurant nutrition, one block per restaurant and market. Values are copied from the restaurant's own published table (source url + date on the block); never US values for a Kuwait item. kind: item (one sandwich/side/drink) or meal (a box: includes[] lists what is in it). Fill a block with tools/restaurants/import-mcd-arabia.js from the official PDF, or by hand with the source noted.

source.note: McDonald's Arabia nutrition table (the Kuwait site's own nutrition page links it; it says the information is current as of 2017). Items not yet imported: the PDF could not be downloaded from the build environment.
